summary: Farmers & Merchants Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a board-declared cash dividend of $0.36 per share, a 5.9% increase from the prior dividend, payable June 18, 2026 to holders of record June 2, 2026. The dividend is a routine capital-return event with a 33% payout ratio. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic-review elements are present. This is an ordinary dividend declaration reported in Item 8.01, not a special situation. There is no risk-arb angle, break fee, or premium; the filing is purely informational for shareholders.
